queryText:
# Hostile validation: PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001 (Phase D plan) before execution

You are the independent hostile reviewer for this round: GPT-6.1-Sol at reasoning effort max through the Codex CLI on LAB-OMARCHY, workspace /home/sharpninja/github/vice-sharp, branch develop. The implementer is a Claude session (claude-fable-5-1-high@ClaudeCode); you are a different agent family by the operator's rule. This is a review of a plan before any of its steps execute; nothing under native/vice has changed, and nothing may change during your review.

FIRST: run the add-profile skill exactly as its SKILL.md says (read every non-skill *.md under /home/sharpninja/.claude/profile in full; currently PROFILE-MERGED.md), then read the ENTIRE AGENTS-README-FIRST.yaml at the workspace root, every line, without printing credentials or API keys. Bootstrap your own supported plugin (mcpserver-codex-plugin, the marker's agent_plugins contract, root /home/sharpninja/github/mcpserver-codex-plugin; verify with Invoke-CodexMcpPlugin.ps1 -Command Status) and open your own review session-log turn through it, titled with a short summary of this request, linked to the parent ids in this directory's request.jsonl (parentSessionId, parentRequestId). Do not repair hooks or environment, do not replay queues, do not cancel historical turns, do not invoke nested reviewers, do not substitute the model. There are no time or turn bounds on this review.

MANDATORY live progress: before analysis and at meaningful checkpoints, emit a TEXT JSON object into your output with timestampLocal (a measured sortable local date and time, never estimated), numeric completionPercent and etaSeconds (null only if genuinely unknown). These are your own reports, not deadlines; do not backfill them at the end.

Operator rulings verbatim (treat as acceptance criteria): D4 (2026-10-19): native restoration approved; "Build artifacts are not code dirt. They should be gitignored."; "restore native/vice means revert the tracked modifications after preserving them, and exclude the build output through git ignore rules instead of deleting it". D3: "No HV until your current scope of work is complete and passes 98/98 holistic self-assessment", clarified "This is a remediation/cleanup phase, not new code"; on 2026-10-20T12:21 the operator stated that plans are hostile-validated under the standing rules, which is why this round exists. 2026-10-20T10:40: "Wait for the Windows trace results first" before Phase D step 1. 10:53: "Before beginning phase D implementation, ensure both omarchy and legion2 have latest desktop build installed via nuke." 10:57 answers: R1 "B: .gitmodules ignore = untracked only"; R2 and R3 "A: retire it now"; R4 "Yes, exclude and keep"; R5 "Yes, add in D2". 12:09: "Hold until LEGION2 reports". Standing rules: never move a file (copy, verify by hash, retain the original until the operator clears deletion); never force-push; PowerShell only, no Python, no Node; every script analyzer-checked and dry-run with -WhatIf; BDPv4 mocks first for every behavior change; VICE is immutable (never edit, patch, generate into, clean or restore native/vice outside this plan's approved steps).

Read end to end, rehashing every pin in input-pins.json before you start and disclosing any drift: docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md (the subject), docs/receipts/handoff/HANDOFF.lockstep-plan.md section 4 Phase D, docs/receipts/handoff/HANDOFF.lockstep-plan.v2.md sections 4 and 11, docs/plans/PLAN-VICE-IMMUTABLE-001.md (Phase 0 and Phase 3), docs/receipts/native-vice/20261004T090000-0500-preexisting-delta/README.md and its patch, docs/plans/PLAN-OBSERVER-001.md with docs/receipts/lockstep/20261020T081800-phase-c-step3-s2b-observer-build-linux/README.md and 20261020T094000-phase-c-step3-s4-observations-linux/README.md (what Phase C rehomed), native/Vice.Native.proj, .gitmodules, native/build-vice-observer.ps1, build/Build.cs (the Test target filter), ViceSharp.slnx, this directory's SELF-REVIEW.md. Verify the plan's state claims yourself: git -C native/vice status --short --untracked-files=no, git -C native/vice diff --stat, git submodule status, the submodule's git dir, the consumers of vice_x64.dll under tests (grep ViceNativeBridge), the projects that reference Vice.Native.proj. Read-only on everything outside this receipt directory; you may run read-only git and grep commands and managed dotnet test commands on the three native-safe projects; never build the full solution, never build native code, never touch native/vice or artifacts/immutable-vice.

Mandatory attack surfaces (profile 7.2): (1) every claim in the plan (state counts, file lists, dispositions, what Phase C proved, the exit gate amendment under R1 B); (2) workspace rules (honesty, receipts, MCP-only storage, PowerShell only, no Python, never move a file, VICE immutable); (3) requirements: the plan is class 1; check it maps to existing FR, TR, TEST and AC (TR-VSFLOCKSTEP-RESUME-001 AC2, TEST-VICE-001 AC1 and AC2, TR-CYCLE-001 AC4, PLAN-VICEORACLE-001 tasks 4 and 5) and names no requirement change without a plan; (4) the plan holistically: definition of done, blockers, amendments, the immutable Phase 3 exit gate as amended by R1 B and D3, phase dependencies (D-pre, D0 to D5, Phase E hand-offs), rollback, both machines. Run the what-if pass per criterion (crash or interruption mid-revert, a LEGION2 delta that differs from the Oct 4 patch, a drive-snapshot hunk the VSF adapter does not cover, a shim consumer outside the excluded categories, a build writing into native/vice after D2, the submodule's own dirty status under R1 B). Chain rules to find deadlocks (never-move-a-file against the immutable Phase 3 "remove only classified paths"; BDPv4 against tooling scripts; HV-before-done against D3). Where the plan does not state an observable outcome, propose a valid AC with the step that owns it; adding a valid AC is a finding of kind "add AC", not a FAIL by itself unless the gap makes a step unsafe.

Save verdict.md, verdict.json and verdict.persistence.json in THIS directory (docs/receipts/hv/20261020T122200-plan-nativerestore-001-gpt61sol/). Required JSON fields: OverallVerdict (AGREE or DISAGREE), accuracyPercent, completenessPercent, passCount, failCount, unknownCount, findings (id, status PASS or FAIL or UNKNOWN or ADD-AC, severity, file and line or section, evidence, rationale, correction), reviewerAgent, reviewerModel, reviewerEffort, reviewerSessionId, reviewerRequestId, requestPath, responsePath. Persist the COMPLETE prose and JSON verdict, every finding and both scores, in your own session-log turn (ordered small chunks if the wrapper's argument limits require it; read back, reassemble, compare hashes, disclose any CRLF/LF normalization), complete the turn and prove its completed state with a history query; write that proof into verdict.persistence.json. A full-content failsafe is authorized only after a genuine primary failure including a failed triage submission; label queued versus persisted. End with the whole verdict in your output stream. OverallVerdict is AGREE only if every applicable surface passes and both scores are at least 98; do not inflate scores; a sub-98 score is DISAGREE even with zero FAIL. No commit, no push, no edit outside this directory.
